props.name: activationMode
props.description:
The activation mode of the tabs. Can be `manual` or `automatic`
- `manual`: Tabs are activated when clicked or press `enter` key.
- `automatic`: Tabs are activated when receiving focus

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: composite
props.description: Whether the tab is composite

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected tab value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected tab value.

props.name: deselectable
props.description: Whether the active tab can be deselected when clicking on it.

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the tabs. Useful for composition.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the keyboard navigation will loop from last tab to first, and vice versa.

props.name: navigate
props.description:
Function to navigate to the selected tab when clicking on it.
Useful if tab triggers are anchor elements.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the focused tab changes

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the selected/active tab changes

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation of the tabs. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical`
- `horizontal`: only left and right arrow key navigation will work.
- `vertical`: only up and down arrow key navigation will work.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled selected tab value

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the tab
